items.title: Fourth Press Briefing on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Search teams have recovered 1010 bodies and rescued more than 11,800 people so far. Around 4,000 remain unaccounted for, including roughly 590 foreign nationals from 39 countries.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Fourth Press Briefing on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Foreign nationals — missing, rescued, or contacted (NDRRMA, 1 Sep)
items.summary: NDRRMA has an update on foreign nationals after the Bhote Koshi flood in Rasuwa. It covers those missing, rescued, or contacted and refers to the Department of Tourism list.
items.citation: NDRRMA Nepal — X post (1 September 2026)

items.title: Embassy of India — identification of mortal remains (1 Sep 2026)
items.summary: Families can check photos and descriptions of remains on the Nepal police disaster site. Relatives can email DNA profiles to the police and copy the Indian embassy, or give blood samples if they are in Nepal.
items.citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — Press Release (1 September 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Rescue teams have recovered 903 bodies from the flood areas, and more than 10,000 people have been brought out safely. About 4,200 remain unaccounted for, including 590 foreign nationals from 39 countries.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Nepal Police — DNA profiling for unidentified remains
items.summary: Relatives of people missing in the Rasuwa and Bhote Koshi floods can help identify recovered bodies through DNA testing. First-degree family members in Nepal can give a blood sample and photos at the Nepal Police Hospital or a district police office, while those abroad should send results from an authorized lab.
items.citation: Nepal Police HQ — Information on DNA Profiling for unidentified Dead Bodies (31 Aug)

items.source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
items.title: NDRRMA — Bhotekoshi water level rising again (31 Aug)
items.summary: Water levels in the Bhotekoshi River have risen again. People in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Chitwan and nearby areas should stay careful.
items.citation: NDRRMA Nepal — public warning via official channels

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the floods on the Bhote Koshi, 734 bodies have been recovered so far and about 2498 people remain unaccounted for. Rescue teams have brought out over 8186 people, including more than 261 foreigners, while over 400 foreign nationals are still missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: After the Bhote Koshi floods, 626 bodies have been recovered and about 2400 people remain unaccounted for. Rescue teams have brought out over 4450 people so far, including more than 187 foreign nationals, with more help arriving from India and China.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: A flash flood hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, with 511 people still missing out of 632 reported from 33 countries.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams and helicopters are working at the mudslide site in Gyirong Port after it hit Wednesday morning. Three people have been killed, 558 remain missing, and two have been rescued so far, with more teams and supplies arriving.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, killing many people and leaving hundreds missing. So far 359 bodies have been recovered, and 596 people from 33 countries are still unaccounted for.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry has set up an emergency room to help with foreign nationals caught in the Rasuwa floods. Families can call or message +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 between 7am and 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India’s foreign ministry has opened a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Families can call +91 11 2308 8718, +91 11 2308 8719 or +91 11 2301 2113, or message +91 9968291988 on WhatsApp.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River this morning, killing people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 72 bodies so far, with 403 people from 25 countries still reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026

items.title: Nepal Police official found and missing lists
items.summary: Nepal Police keeps the main list of people missing or found after the floods, including any unidentified remains. Only they can confirm someone's status, so don't rely on other websites or social media posts.
items.citation: Nepal Police UDB — udb.nepalpolice.gov.np

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu is working with Nepalese authorities on search, rescue, and identification after the floods. Families can contact them at eoikathmandufloodsupport@gmail.com or these WhatsApp numbers: +977-9851316807, +977-9709107500, +977-9810326117.
items.citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu
